artifact_snapshot_rule: hash, parse and use operate on one immutable in-memory byte snapshot; paths are never reopened

canonical_serialization.equivalent_input_escapes: input spellings such as \n and \u000a parse to the same string and must serialize only as \n
canonical_serialization.numbers: integers only in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991], canonical base-10 decimal; floats and negative zero are forbidden
canonical_serialization.objects: unique keys sorted by Unicode scalar-value lexicographic order
canonical_serialization.other_controls: U+0000..U+001F not listed above use exactly lowercase \u00xx
canonical_serialization.unicode: all keys and string values must contain Unicode scalar values only and already be NFC
canonical_serialization.whitespace: none outside strings; comma and colon separators only

formal_reference.scope: gate matrix only; not a proof of replay or validator soundness

projection.purpose: bind candidate-controlled input, declarations, events, ledger and candidate_result without a self-hash cycle

raw_parse_domain.negative_zero: reject the exact JSON integer token -0 before conversion to an integer object
raw_parse_domain.unpaired_surrogates: parse may expose the code unit only so the explicit Unicode-scalar domain check can reject it
